text:
sam: heads-up eu-central1 nvme IOPS collapsed after a GC job overlapped with janitor. GPU attaches piling. anyone see this?

sre-bot: ALERT: pool=eu-central1-local read_p99=470ms over 5m; attach_fail_rate up.

toni: saw a hotstripe GC scan + janitor vacuum start at same time. lots of small reads.

lee: mitigation: stopped janitor, moved GC workers into a low-IO cgroup, and flipped routing pref to us-west2 for 20m. commands: `sudo systemctl stop ephemeral-janitor` + cgroup v2 io.max write + move pids.

sam: p99 back to ~35ms on sample node. filing INFRA-9402 to add GC/Janitor interlock and IO-headroom preflight. cost note: regional flip adds small egress hit but prevented SLA breach.

sre-bot: ACTION: janitor paused, GC workers rate-limited, routing pref updated. monitoring eu-central1 for 30m.
